result.summary: Adds functional test assertions to test/functional/rpc_createmultisig.py for multisig creation error boundaries. Specifically, it exercises the error paths when nrequired is less than 1 and when nrequired exceeds the number of provided keys.
result.problem: The shared RPC multisig creation helper enforces that nrequired must be at least 1 and no greater than the number of provided keys, but neither error condition had functional test coverage.
evidence: PR description: "The sibling '>20 keys' limit is already covered in rpc_createmultisig.py, but neither of these two bounds was exercised by any functional test. This adds assertions for both."
result.scope_notes: Small test-only PR (+12/-0) adding assertions to an existing functional test.
result.card: Adds functional test coverage in rpc_createmultisig.py for createmultisig boundary checks where nrequired is below 1 or exceeds the number of provided keys. These error paths in the shared multisig RPC helper were previously unexercised in functional tests. It is a minor test coverage improvement with no production code changes and no external dependencies.

risk.why: A mistake would only cause a false positive failure or missed check in the functional test suite.
